description: This file contains functions and types for redacting sensitive information from text, including pattern definitions, regex parsing, and configuration resolution.

methods.name: redactSensitiveText
methods.description: Redacts sensitive information from the input text based on configuration and patterns.

methods.name: redactToolDetail
methods.description: Redacts sensitive details in a string if the mode is set to 'tools'.

methods.name: getDefaultRedactPatterns
methods.description: Returns the default list of regex patterns used for redaction.
